text:
emma: quick follow-up from the DB incident — we need a tighter postmortem follow-up process. proposing a 3-phase timeline + clear owners and an IC rotation for followups. ideas? :eyes:

raj: +1. can we make the phases concrete with SLAs and a small checklist for each phase? also add a recurrence-detection column (weak signal => bucket). :thumbsup:

hannah: suggested owners: triage -> oncall IC, remediation -> service owner, validation -> reliability owner. also propose a 2-week IC rotation for followups so nobody owns forever.

marc: agree on rotation. also: include a short template that PMs can read and sign off if user-impacting. put JIRA link in root so it's searchable. example: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1234

emma: rough template draft (keeping it tiny so folks actually fill it):

```
Phase 0: 0-24h (Triage)
- Owner: oncall IC
- Deliverable: 1-paragraph blameless summary, priority, blocker list, assigned remediation ticket(s)
- SLA: initial summary within 4h, ticket created within 12h

Phase 1: 24-72h (Remediation)
- Owner: remediation lead (service owner)
- Deliverable: list of action items with owners + due dates, mitigation deployed or rollback, postmortem skeleton started
- SLA: remediation plan assigned within 24h of triage

Phase 2: 72h-30d (Validation & Closure)
- Owner: validation lead (reliability/ops)
- Deliverable: tests/runbook updated, regression checks, recurrence signal review, final postmortem published
- SLA: followup validation scheduled within 7 days, closure within 30 days or documented exception
```

raj: nit: add a tiny column for "recurrence signal" with values {none, suspected, confirmed} and a brief evidence pointer (logs/tag/version). helps prioritize long-term fixes.

hannah: for ownership tracking, suggest a single lightweight board with columns: triage, in-remediation, validation, done. each card MUST have owner + due date. weekly remediation office hours to unblock owners.

marc: on IC rotation — proposal: 2-week oncall IC handles Phase 0, but followup IC (rotating volunteer) picks up Phase 1 ownership for their fortnight. i.e., rotate followup ownership every 2 weeks. exportable schedule:

```
Week 1-2: followup IC = emma
Week 3-4: followup IC = raj
Week 5-6: followup IC = hannah
(etc)
```

oncall-bot: created followup task https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1234-1 for remediation owner assignment. :white_check_mark:

emma: action items from thread: 1) hannah to prototype the Trello/Board columns and automation (due in 3 days). 2) raj to add recurrence-signal field to postmortem template (due 48h). 3) marc to publish IC rotation cadence and small signup sheet (due EOW). I'll draft a one-page playbook for quick reference.

raj: I'll add the recurrence-signal field and a tiny dropdown in the template. also will add a link to the runbook checklist.

hannah: prototyping now, will ping when board has automation to auto-assign owner based on ticket label.

marc: will send rotation schedule + signup doc in #people-ops and add a calendar invite for the first 2-week block.

emma: thanks — if no major objections I'll convert this into a post-incident followup template and attach it to the postmortem in RI-1234 within 24h. :sparkles:

raj: +1

hannah: +1

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: followup owners check-in in 72h (thread 1727777777).

emma: ok closing thread for now, will reopen on the ticket after template is attached.
